title: Balance fear and balance culture
user_thinking: Balance anxiety is specific: a feature "would absolutely destroy the pvp system"; fruit normals must stay viable if only ults are un-cancellable or "gun m1 cancels Red Hawk" becomes the meta disaster; one-shot combos "destroy every system". evidence.text: Adding this would absolutely destroy the pvp system honestly

The cutscenes are cool and all, but hopefully fruits normal moves will be balanced out and actually viable with this system, I'm still unsure about all moves except for ults being cancellable with the different types of m1s. It would just be lame for a player to be charging up a signature move of that fruit like fire fist or if they used red hawk for rubber, and it gets cancelled by a gun m1 or a little stab from a dagger. I might be a little outdated, but for now all I know is that all moves except for ults are cancellable, and mixing that in with the different m1s would make most fruit users have to rely on running or using cutscene stun lock combos to actually survive, and that just seems like a disaster for a combat system, so I hoped that does get fixed, and this could be fixed with adding fast startup to moves or messing around with the stuns and effects of each move. I just figured since devil fruits were going to be harder to get, they should at least be special. That doesn't mean the other combat styles should be forgotten about, and hopefully this could be balanced out with other abilities players can get like armament being able to block devil fruit attacks or deflect  them, or literally being able to punch back or cancel out devil fruit attacks for a brief moment if they have mastered haki, or making strong swordsman able to cut through haki attacks like cutting a giant fireball in two or slashing meteors apart.
